transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, my work physical is what actually got me here. The doctor doing the exam told me my weight is too low and wanted me to come in. 

Honestly, I don't really see it as a problem. To me, I just feel... I don't know, lighter on my feet for basketball. And I don't feel as weighed down when I'm moving around the garage at work. But they told me I needed to come see you, so here I am.
Have you been eating less than usual on purpose, or have you just not felt like eating lately?

I guess it's mostly on purpose. Most days I just keep it to coffee in the morning. Then later on, maybe I'll have a small sandwich or just half of whatever is around. 

With the shop running late all the time and things always being busy at the house, I just... I feel better sticking to my own simple rules with food. It keeps things manageable for me.
Do you ever worry about gaining weight or feel like you need to lose more weight, even if others might tell you that you're already at a low weight?

Yeah, I definitely worry about it. If I see the scale bump up even a pound, or if my jeans start feeling just a little tighter, it really bothers me. I start thinking I'm getting soft, you know? Like I'm going to be slower moving around the cars at the shop, or I won't be able to get up and down the court as well when I play basketball. So, yeah, I do try to keep the weight off, even if other people think it's too low.
Have you ever made yourself sick or used anything like laxatives or diuretics to help keep your weight down?
No, I haven't done anything like that. I don't make myself throw up, and I don't take any pills or anything to lose weight. I just control what I eat.
